description: Velo V2 — clean-room rebuild. Current surface: Ask, Plan, and Run.

plugins.name: velo
plugins.description: Velo V2 — three modes: Ask (off-axis, read-only conceptual Q&A that never touches the repo), Plan (a persisted, versioned plan saved under .velo/ with an explicit approval freeze — planning only, never execution), and Run (executes a frozen, approved plan milestone by milestone, gated by green checks plus one independent review, committing locally — never pushing, merging, or opening PRs). No mode starts Auto.
